items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Medium+ surface=none needs a closed surface_none code; F11 re-derives UI / API route / SSE-WS / message-contract surfaces from the merge-base diff (paths, changed lines and full file content) and refuses none; tests_run/exit_code are cross-checked against the staged evidence tied to the verified commit (ancestry + tested_tree fingerprint) and to the detected surface; absent and stale both tested.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Not a git work tree, unmeasurable diff, unreadable patch/contents, unloadable collector, missing or unreadable fingerprint all fail closed with a repair; a fingerprint that cannot be taken never crashes staging (None, read as stale).

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No shell; git via argument arrays; runner paths are only matched, never opened; provenance report names stay restricted by fresh_evidence; the temp index never touches the real index (tested).

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Real git repos and the production evidence_drop staging per case: absent, foreign run, off-line revision, later code fix, amended edit after staging, merge from trunk and records-only commits (fresh), failing staged test, too few passes, unmatched runner path, web without Playwright, UI with cli, detected route with a bare curl runner, handler body edit, precedence of the diff over the code.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Measured on real sibling worktrees: 18k staged results parsed in 0.7-0.8 s; working_tree_id 1.0 s on this worktree; a few bounded git calls with timeouts, only at medium+.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: check moved to verifiers/surface_check.py (re-exported; iterate_checks.py 853 -> 765), helpers _surface_detect/_surface_evidence/_surface_revision/_surface_git, lib/worktree_tree.py; every file < 300; surface_verification.py 463 -> 453; capped test files did not grow.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer->consumer probes run for real: surface_verification.py --reason-code JSON -> F5c entry -> check (pass, then refused after a route commit); evidence_drop provenance (new tested_tree key) -> _surface_revision; the gate run against U1/U3/U4's real staged evidence and F5c entries.
